title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：noise　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 noise 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the warden ① made the noise that no resident in the centre would have measured, and he said the making was the whole of the month. The ② noise, meaning the sound itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; noise, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of noise in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ noise at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Noise, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the warden said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the noise was the whole of the matter, meaning the trouble and not the sound. The ⑥ noise, meaning the trouble and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; noise, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both sound and a trouble. He said the trouble is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ noise had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ noise of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of measuring; noise, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ noise I remember is the noise measured in the register, which closed in 1989 and is still measured as the quietest in the centre. ⑩ Noise, my mother said in 1991, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all noise, she said, is a trouble that has agreed to look like sound. She said the trouble was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 噪声；响声（指社区中心里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 噪声；响声（指那阵噪声本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the noise 弄出这一阵噪声
D. n. 噪声；响声（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 噪声之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的噪声之事）
F. n. 噪声；响声（指登记册里写到、被测量的那一阵）
G. n. 噪声、烦扰（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 烦扰（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the noise that no resident in the centre would have measured
The noise, meaning the sound itself and not the notice
Every sort of noise in that centre
the noise at the far gate
the noise was the whole of the matter
the noise had become a line in a register
The noise of the whole thing

answers.why: make the noise 意为“弄出这一阵噪声”，1982 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯测量的一阵噪声做了一遍。
noise 意为“噪声；响声”，指那阵噪声本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
noise 意为“噪声；响声”，指社区中心里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
noise 意为“噪声；响声”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
noise 意为“噪声、烦扰”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这阵烦扰就是那件事的全部。
noise 意为“烦扰”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那阵噪声，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
noise 意为“噪声；响声”，指登记册里写到、被测量的那一阵，到 1987 年这一阵成了登记册里的一行。
noise 意为“噪声之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的噪声之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的测量。
noise 意为“噪声；响声”，我记得的是登记册里测量过的那一阵，1989 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一阵。
noise 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，噪声是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的噪声。
